T-shirt design for a Tire Brand

Title says it all. I designed this t-shirt in 2011 for a Tire/Automotive Repair Chain. They held a contest that awarded each store location these t-shirts, based on how many tires they sold.

The front, left chest, design is/was the current horizontal format logo branding for Nitto (no changes made - other than sizing the logo for a left chest imprint).

Back of t-shirt: The client gave us a free creative license to come up with whatever design we wanted for the back; just as long as it included the parent company's name, Nitto, and the current tire line "Terra Grappler" text that they were trying to promote. We opted to go with a techy/futuristic theme that would coordinate well with the Nitto brand's typography. The back had to be limited to a 1 CLR spot color screen print (due to limited budget for the t-shirts). The simulated tones of Grays were done by use of Halftones. The screen printer that decorated the shirts used a 30%, 60%, and 100% spot white ink to simulate three different shades of color.
